svg.aria-label: Fernly quality radar: required bar versus actual state, with two axes unknown
svg.title: Fernly — quality radar (derived from quality/strategy.md, 2026-06-11)
svg.desc: Radar of Fernly's eleven risk-map dimensions. The green polygon is the required bar (High dimensions at the outer ring, Medium at the inner). The terracotta line is the actual state, judged from the strategy's own words. Two axes — reminder delivery and household sync — are Unknown: no oracle exists to judge them, so the actual line breaks and the wedge is hatched. The holes in the map are the headline.
svg.metadata: { "project": "Fernly", "derivedFrom": "quality/strategy.md", "strategyDate": "2026-06-11", "view": "quality radar — required vs actual", "scaleNote": "actual positions are a judged read of the risk map's prose, not measurements; the strategy body wins", "axes": [ {"id":"1a","name":"Reminder delivery","required":"H","actual":"Unknown — zero delivery telemetry","conf":"—"}, {"id":"1b","name":"Schedule correctness","required":"H","actual":"known-good, property-tested (~400 cases/run)","conf":"H","position":1.0}, {"id":"2","name":"Photo integrity","required":"H","actual":"upload path solid, restore never drilled","conf":"M–L","position":0.55}, {"id":"3a","name":"Plant-ID accuracy","required":"M","actual":"over-confident — 'feels fine', unmeasured","conf":"L","position":0.45}, {"id":"4","name":"Household sync","required":"H","actual":"Unknown — convergence never tested","conf":"—"}, {"id":"5","name":"Payment/entitlement","required":"H","actual":"no reconciliation; edge paths unexercised","conf":"L–M","position":0.30}, {"id":"6","name":"Offline behavior","required":"M","actual":"photo queue solid; multi-day untested","conf":"M–H","position":0.70}, {"id":"7","name":"Sensor pairing","required":"M","actual":"known-poor — 31% of support inbound","conf":"L on why","position":0.30}, {"id":"8","name":"Photo privacy","required":"H","actual":"known-good — signed URLs, authz suite, pen-test","conf":"H","position":0.95}, {"id":"10","name":"App-store polish","required":"M","actual":"mostly known-good; new paywall unreviewed","conf":"M–H","position":0.80}, {"id":"12","name":"Support observability","required":"M","actual":"known-poor — an hour per ticket","conf":"H (poor)","position":0.25} ] }
svg.text: FERNLY · QUALITY RADAR · R1 “TRUST REPAIR” ARC
The shape of where we stand — holes included.

g.text: actual state, in the doc's words
uncharted — no oracle can judge it yet
The two holes are the headline: reminder
and household sync have no oracle at all.
Phase 0 builds the delivery ledger before
Where the line runs close to the rim —
schedule math, photo privacy — the doc has
real evidence: a property suite, an authz
test suite and a pen-test. Not vibes.
* 3a is rendered low because its evidence is low —
the doc calls the “feels fine” read over-confident.
Positions are a judged read of the risk map's
prose, not measurements. The body wins.
